EmailTemplate.subject: Register Now [Free Webinar]: "Leadership: The Silver Bullet of an Agency AND Empowering Customers to Buy Life Insurance" (2-Part Webinar) with Joel Laird (hosted by Chandler Hahn)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Lead.FirstName}, Join multiple award winning captive agent Joel Laird on Wednesday, July 15, 2020 @ 2:00 PM Eastern (11:00 AM Pacific) for a webinar presentation on "Leadership: The Silver Bullet of an Agency AND Empowering Customers to Buy Life Insurance" (2-part webinar) with Joel Laird (hosted by Chandler Hahn). Joel’s presentations will focus on two crucial areas agents should be focused on – leadership and increasing your overall sales of life insurance. Joel will discuss:
- The importance of having a clearly articulated vision so your people know WHY their work matters - Why good leaders are always optimistic for the future, yet grounded in the here and now - How to simplify life insurance for customers to help them make informed decisions - Changing the life insurance conversation from money to time
Joel took over his first agency with his carrier back in 2008, and since then has forged a very successful career path. He inherited a team ranked in the bottom 5% of his company (#479 of 529) and within 3 years achieved a ranking in the top 10% (#40 of 529) company-wide.
You can sign-up for the free webinar directly through our link here: https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_bKKH7uKWRLquh5e4UdwmFQ
Best,
Dennis
